title_or_table: American Community Survey, 2025 1-year estimates, Data Profile DP03, Selected Economic Characteristics: health insurance coverage
table_id: DP03_0095 to DP03_0099 (estimates, margins and percents)
unit: people; pct in percent of the civilian noninstitutionalized population; margins at the 90 percent level
qualification: Survey estimates with 90 percent margins of error. A person may hold private and public coverage at once, so the two counts sum to more than the insured. The Bureau counts employer-based, direct-purchase and TRICARE coverage as private, and Medicare, Medicaid and other means-tested coverage and VA care as public.

coverage.description: the line’s label, as the Bureau prints it

pct.description: percent of the civilian noninstitutionalized population

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, 2025, Data Profile DP03, health insurance coverage, civilian noninstitutionalized population, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Survey estimates; a person may hold private and public coverage at once.
notes: The uninsured share is 8.4 percent (margin 0.1), so the data lead’s Euler at true area with no frame holds (sign-off condition for rows 117 and 118)
